subject: Signer cadence and final go/no-go playbook
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signer cadence and final go/no-go playbook

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached the latest mutual action plan (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf) and the updated SOW (SOW_NovaCorp_v2.docx). The objective this week is to lock the final approval sequence so procurement/legal can route signatures and we can confirm a start date.

Proposed timeline / asks:
- Fri 4/2 — NovaCorp internal approvers confirm signer identities + procurement PO timing.
- Tue 4/6 — final go/no-go (30 min) with engineering, security, and procurement on the call.
- Wed 4/7 — eSign window opens; 48-hour signer cadence with explicit owner and backup signer.
- Mon 4/12 — target start date (environment provisioning + kickoff).

Key operational notes in the MAP:
- Approval flow: Procurement -> Legal -> Engineering (security clearance) -> Exec sign-off.
- eSign plan: DocuSign envelope in routing order; primary signer (Tom Hsu), backup signer (Clara Jensen).
- Contingency: If procurement needs an extra vendor-security confirmation, we can provide SOC2 artifacts and a short call with our security lead.

Can you confirm: (1) the two people who will sign and their email addresses, (2) any procurement lead time we should account for (PO timeline), and (3) whether 4/12 is acceptable as a start target?

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf, SOW_NovaCorp_v2.docx

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@novacorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Signer cadence and final go/no-go playbook

Sean —

Appreciate the clear plan and the MAP. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Signers: Primary signer will be Tom Hsu (Head of Data Products). Backup will be me (Clara).
- PO timing: Procurement needs to issue the PO prior to eSign; typical internal window is 3 business days after contract terms are finalized. We may be able to compress this to 2 days if legal and finance sign off quickly.
- Security gating: Our InfoSec team has one outstanding checklist item around data retention for embeddings; they asked for a short Q&A and the SOC2 evidence.

Question: Can Redwood guarantee the DocuSign envelope routing order? Procurement prefers a single envelope with the routing order defined, rather than multiple documents. We also request a 72-hour window for our legal to complete a last pass on the SOW language.

If possible, push the eSign open window to Wed 4/7 and allow until Fri 4/9 for signatures — that gives our legal the 72-hour review. Start date 4/12 still looks doable if the PO is issued on 4/9.

Forwarding our internal procurement note below for visibility.

Thanks,
Clara
Clara Jensen
Sr. Procurement Manager, NovaCorp
clara.jensen@novacorp.com

[Procurement note: vendor onboarding checklist attached — requires vendor security assurance and PO issuance timeline]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signer cadence and final go/no-go playbook

Clara —

Thanks for the details and the procurement note. We can do the single DocuSign envelope with explicit routing order. Proposed routing order:
1) Procurement (Tom Hsu)
2) Legal (NovaCorp in parallel review)
3) Redwood exec (Laura Bennett) — final sign-off

We will open the envelope on Wed 4/7 at 10:00 PT and leave the envelope open through Fri 4/9 17:00 PT to accommodate the 72-hour legal window. Attached is a calendar stub (Signature_Window.ics) for the 4/7 go/no-go call — agenda: 1) Procurement & legal status; 2) Security checklist closure; 3) Confirm signer emails and eSign envelope owner; 4) Confirm start date and provisioning timeline.

Karthik — can you confirm Redwood legal is okay with the SOW language as attached? If there are redlines, please flag them prior to the 4/7 call so Clara's team has a clean SOW for review.

Monica — can you prepare the onboarding runbook and a short checklist of what we need provisioned for day 1 (compute profiles, VPC peering, staging data load)? We should surface that during the go/no-go so procurement and engineering align on timelines.

DocuSign link will be sent as soon as procurement confirms the PO issuance plan. If procurement needs our SOC2 artifacts ahead of the call, Karthik can provide the Evidence Pack.

Attachments: Signature_Window.ics

Best,
Sean

On a related note — Clara, would you like us to include an explicit backup signer in the envelope (Clara) so procurement can route directly if Tom is delayed? That would shorten the critical path.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: greenlight for signature window and start date (brief)

Team —

Quick confirmation from exec side: I reviewed the MAP and SOW. Legal (Karthik) to clear any final redlines by EOD 4/6. Provided legal is clear, greenlight to open DocuSign on 4/7 at 10:00 PT with the envelope order Sean proposed.

Signature cadence guidance:
- Primary signer window: 4/7 10:00 PT -> 4/9 17:00 PT
- If Tom cannot sign within 24 hours, allow automatic escalation to backup (Clara) to keep schedule.
- Procurement to issue PO no later than 4/9 close to meet 4/12 start.

Monica — confirm provisioning checklist and capacity slots by tomorrow AM so we can communicate any blockers in the go/no-go call.

Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

[Signature: Redwood Inference — Production-ready inference runtime]
